summary: Frontend-only testing of the new TRADE page bottom 3-card row (AVERAGE/SBM/TP) on LIVE bot cards and the Average manual-DCA modal. All 9 acceptance checks passed end-to-end against the preview URL as admin@tgxbot.com. Found 11 LIVE bot cards each exposing bot-average-btn-<SYMBOL>, bot-sbm-btn-<SYMBOL>, and bot-tp-<SYMBOL>; old 'ROUND N' / '-> NOW' line is gone. TP shows '+1.5%'. SBM shows 'SBM — Coming soon' toast. AVERAGE modal opens with Current Avg Price/Loss/Position, editable amount input, live-updating preview (New Position $20→$32 when amount=12 on LITUSDT), START disabled for amount<10 and enabled for amount>=10, Cancel closes modal, and START executes: success toast 'LIT averaged · New Avg $0.7430' appears and modal closes with card data refreshing (buys count re-fetched).

issues: When current loss is 0% (e.g. LITUSDT just-averaged), the Buy Amount input prefill is empty and helper reads 'Suggested $0 · buys from your exchange balance'. Not a functional bug (START is correctly disabled), but a nicer UX would be to default to a floor of $10 or show the exchange balance as a hint.

critical_code_review_comments: Suggested-buy prefill falls back to empty string when backend returns suggested_buy=0 — consider defaulting to max($10, next_buy_margin) so the UI isn't blank on recently-averaged bots.
Many Binance websocket 451 errors in console (regional block from preview infra) — purely env noise, but adding a graceful retry/backoff with REST polling fallback would reduce console spam.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded running bots; executed one small $12 average on LITUSDT in Demo mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new AVERAGE/SBM/TP controls verified on /trades. Testids follow pattern bot-average-btn-<SYMBOL>, bot-sbm-btn-<SYMBOL>, bot-tp-<SYMBOL>; modal uses average-modal, average-amount-input, average-start, average-cancel. START executes via POST /api/bots/{symbol}/average and card data refreshes automatically. Admin has 11 RUNNING bots in Demo mode against live Binance prices.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — feature works as specified.
